interactions.summary: The reading gives the suicide-tree's speech of loyal service and despair, and Jiang reframes the figure as a virtuous counselor who killed himself after false treason charges.
A student says suicide abandons faith, hope, and love and damages other people's ability to connect, and Jiang strongly endorses that answer.
The reading explains how suicides become thorn-bushes in the wood and will only repossess their bodies as hanging burdens after the final judgment.
The canto shifts to the squanderers pursued by black bitches and ends with another wounded tree speaking through blood.

speaker_notes.note: The speech is highly compressed and ASR-noisy in names, but the core content is clear: a faithful court servant undone by envy who chose death in despair.

claims.claim: Jiang interprets the suicide-tree as a historically known counselor who was virtuous and talented, falsely accused of treason, and then killed himself in despair.
A student says suicide rejects faith, hope, and love and also damages society by impairing other people's capacity to love and connect.
Jiang says suicide is the opposite of faith, hope, and love because it rejects God as savior and turns a gifted person into a destructive example for others.
The canto says suicides are thrown into the seventh circle's wood, sprout where chance drops them, and only recover their bodies as hanging signs of what they cast away.
The packet broadens violence against the self by adding the squanderers, who are chased and torn apart by black bitches through the same violent wood.

signature_moments.moment: Suicide says even God cannot save me.
signature_moments.source_phrase: this is so hopeless, even God can't save me
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It is Jiang's sharpest psychological definition of suicide as theological abandonment.

signature_moments.moment: The body you threw away returns only as a hanging burden on your stump.
signature_moments.source_phrase: It is not right for any man to have what he himself has cast aside
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This is the packet's most powerful image of self-rejection becoming permanent form.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: The second ring of violence in which suicide and self-destruction are punished through loss of bodily form and continual torment.
The creatures that feed on the leaves of the suicide trees, producing pain that becomes their outlet for speech.

chronology_notes.note: This packet takes the suicide-tree from personal testimony into Jiang's moral interpretation, then widens the ring to include the hunted squanderers.

uncertainty_notes.note: Proper names and one chase reference are ASR-rough, but the scene of self-destructive souls pursued by black bitches is clear.
